title: Version history

versions.name: Trees
versions.summary: Seattle street and park tree map; season, planting and species views; tilted diorama; LiDAR canopy; parks and creeks; sunlight
changes: Added: trees.exe, in Tools > Map. Every Seattle street tree, from City of Seattle SDOT data
Added: Season view (trees.exe). Bloom, leaf and fall color by day of year, playable
Added: Planted view (trees.exe). Trees standing by year, newest highlighted, playable
Added: Species view (trees.exe). Commonest genera by color, click one to isolate

Added: Tilt view (trees.exe). City diorama on USGS elevation, tilt angle slider, 8 headings
Added: Canopy toggle (trees.exe). 850k park and yard trees from the 2021 LiDAR survey
Added: removed street trees on the Planted timeline (trees.exe). Red in their removal year
Fixed: street tree data blocked on the live site (trees.exe). Served as a 404
Changed: bots command excludes the owner's own traffic (bash.exe). Ignore list kept on the server
Added: Seattle Parks tree inventory (trees.exe). 21,779 park trees with species and size
Added: Parks layer (trees.exe). Park boundaries, forest restoration zones, P-Patch gardens
Added: Water layer (trees.exe). SPU creeks, piped stretches dashed
Added: Street layer (trees.exe). Street trees can be hidden
Changed: view buttons moved into View menu (trees.exe). Trees, Map and Layer submenus
Changed: Species and Planted views renamed Type and Age (trees.exe)
Changed: turn buttons replaced by facing slider (trees.exe). Any angle; Q and E step 15°
Changed: Fit renamed Reset (trees.exe). Also returns tilt, facing, sun time, day and year
Added: park, garden and creek details on click (trees.exe). Area, phase, plots, tree count
Added: Sun light in Tilt (trees.exe). Real sun position by hour, hill and tree shadows, night
Changed: season timing tuned to USA-NPN observations (trees.exe). Leaf-out, color, leaf drop
Fixed: Ship Canal water in Tilt (trees.exe). Lake Union joined to the Sound and Lake Washington
Fixed: tree data failing to load just after an update (trees.exe). Stale cached copy refetched
